name: Columbia (STS-1)
about: Columbia (STS-1) (1981-034A), a crewed vehicle (OV-102), launched 1981 Apr 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1981 Apr 13), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW23); its coordinates are written from memory
